title: The internal tool nobody uses, and why it was built anyway

videos.script: Coreto's Platform team once spent eleven hundred hours building a deploy portal. {{portal}} At a hundred and fifty reais an hour, that is a hundred and sixty-five thousand reais. Six months after launch, three of Coreto's forty-one services deployed through it. {{three}} Every company has a tool like this one. It works, it was built with care, and hardly anybody opens it. This lesson does the autopsy. We look at what happened, and at why capable engineers built it anyway. Building is visible. Nobody asked the people who would use it. And it solved the builders' own problem. {{why}} Then we look forward. Four steps, taken before the first line of code, would have found the answer cheaply. And there is a decision about the portal that is still open, which money already spent must not be allowed to make. {{before}} By the end, you can recognise the next one of these while it is still a proposal. That is the only time stopping it is cheap. {{proposal}}
